tools.name: search_prices
tools.description: Find current prices for a product on sharpest.ai: GPUs, CPUs, RAM, SSDs, phones, laptops, cameras, consoles, Pokemon and other trading cards, LEGO, and everyday staples priced per unit (batteries, coffee, cables...). Returns today's lowest and median US eBay Buy It Now asking price (item + shipping,

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Today's price summary for one sharpest.ai product page (a URL from search_prices): lowest and median asking price, listing count, 30-day low, high and change.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories sharpest.ai tracks, with the keys the other tools take: eBay product categories (GPUs, storage, RAM, phones, cameras, cards...) and per-unit staple groups (batteries, coffee, cables...).

tools.name: price_per_unit
tools.description: Cheapest price per unit, best first: per GB/TB for storage and RAM, per GB of VRAM for GPUs, per battery, per ounce, per foot of cable and so on. category = a key from list_categories (e.g. 'storage', 'ram', 'gpus', 'Batteries', 'Coffee & tea'). Optional condition for eBay categories: new, used or r

tools.name: deals
tools.description: Today's deals: products whose cheapest listing is well under their own 30-day average low (or, for new products, under today's typical price). Optional category key from list_categories.

tools.name: used_vs_new
tools.description: How much buying used or refurbished saves vs new, typical price vs typical price, for a category key from list_categories (not collectibles).

tools.name: price_moves
tools.description: Biggest price moves over the last week across all tracked products (typical asking price, then vs now), falling and rising.
